'''Security Force Regulation 11-95''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] regulation which demanded that conversations between [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Police officer/Legends|officers]] and non-security personnel were to be kept to a minimum.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
